summary: ansible-core 2.19 no longer supports multi-pass templating, where templates embedded inside other templates or expressions were rendered again, because it could execute untrusted templates.
questions: Can I nest {{ }} templates inside other templates in ansible-core 2.19?
Why did nested templating stop working after upgrading?

answer_card.title: Multi-pass templating was removed
answer_card.answer_md: Embedding templates inside other templates or expressions used to allow a second rendering pass, which could execute **untrusted** templates. The new templating engine in ansible-core 2.19 no longer supports this insecure behavior, so reference variables directly instead of nesting `{{ }}`.
